item.name: Monarch
item.mainEffect: Massive damage boost with a small SPA and range bonus, but one placement only.
item.dpsIncrease: Placement-dependent damage value; strongest on low-placement units.
item.bestFor: Low-placement or high-cost units, especially units with three placements or fewer.
item.tierDetails: Source table lists placement-limit damage value by original placement limit: 1 +344.4%, 2 +122.2%, 3 +48.1%, 4 +11.1%, 5 -11.1%, 6 -25.9%.
item.cardSummary: Monarch is the rarest listed trait and trades one-placement limit for a huge damage boost plus small speed and range gains.

item.name: Ethereal
item.mainEffect: Boosts damage, attack speed, and range.
item.bestFor: Low-cost units, support units, and units with four or more placements.
item.cardSummary: Ethereal is a Mythic pity trait focused on overall combat output through damage, faster attacks, and a small range boost.

item.name: Deadeye
item.mainEffect: Raises critical chance and critical damage.
item.bestFor: Units that already have Critical Chance in their kit.
item.tierDetails: Source note says Critical Damage can be higher with Hercool and Mr Boo buffs.
item.cardSummary: Deadeye is a Mythic pity trait for crit-focused units, adding critical chance and critical damage instead of basic damage or range stats.

item.name: Solar
item.mainEffect: Large range boost with smaller damage and SPA bonuses.
item.bestFor: Units that value extra reach while still benefiting from modest DPS gains.
item.tierDetails: Source note says Cha-In (Blade Dancer) has different DPS math with this trait.
item.cardSummary: Solar is a Mythic pity trait that heavily favors range while still giving a smaller damage and attack-speed bump.

item.name: Blitz
item.bestFor: Damage dealers that benefit from faster attack cycles.
item.cardSummary: Blitz is a combat trait built around speed, reducing SPA by 20% for a listed 25% DPS increase.

item.name: Marksman
item.bestFor: Units whose role depends heavily on range.
item.cardSummary: Marksman gives a large range boost and is most useful when a unit's value comes from reaching more lanes or targets.

item.name: Fortune
item.mainEffect: Improves economy value through farm income or lower upgrade cost.
item.cashOrCostEffect: +20% Cash income for farm units; -10% upgrade cost for non-farm units
item.bestFor: Farm units such as Sprintwagon and Takaroda, or expensive non-farm upgrade paths.
item.cardSummary: Fortune is the economy trait, boosting farm-unit Cash income or cutting upgrade costs on non-farm units.

item.name: Scholar
item.bestFor: Units being leveled rather than optimized for immediate combat output.
item.cardSummary: Scholar is a leveling trait, giving extra experience instead of direct combat stats.

item.name: Vigor
item.bestFor: General damage improvement when rarer traits are not available.
item.tierDetails: Vigor 1: +5% Damage; Vigor 2: +10% Damage; Vigor 3: +15% Damage.
item.cardSummary: Vigor is a common tiered damage trait with three listed levels from +5% to +15% damage.

item.name: Swift
item.bestFor: Units that benefit from faster attacks.
item.tierDetails: Swift 1: -5% SPA; Swift 2: -7.5% SPA; Swift 3: -12.5% SPA.
item.cardSummary: Swift is a common tiered speed trait with three listed SPA reductions and matching DPS increases.

item.name: Range
item.bestFor: Units that need more reach but do not require the larger Marksman boost.
item.tierDetails: Range 1: +5% Range; Range 2: +10% Range; Range 3: +15% Range.
item.cardSummary: Range is a common tiered range trait with three listed levels from +5% to +15% range.
